notes.title: Rhythm Bang v1.0.1
notes.content:
Bugfixes
- Mapping: Flash colors can now be adjusted to #FFFFFF
- Song select: Fixed local highscore not hiding when it doesn't exist on custom maps
- Gameplay: Fixed a bug where flash events wouldn't play after you died with no fail on
- Mapping: Fixed a power of 0 on cubes not being instant spawing
- Mapping: Fixed the jank when using shift to select multiple consecutive cubes
- Song select: Reduced the amount of rendered songs from 20 to 12 as only 10 could be seen anyway
Changes
- Pause menu: Added volume slider
- Mapping: Added auto play
- Mapping: Added bounds for top parameter on all types
- Modifiers: Removed 'Manual' modifier as it does not align with the game's vision
- Auto play: Disable score pop up
- Mapping: Added save and exit button
